provided.title: File:Closeup view of Kenyan Government Buildings from Uhuru Park.jpg

observed.caption: People relaxing on a grassy hill under a cloudy sky with a tall flagpole flying the Kenyan flag and buildings in the background.
observed.description: A wide outdoor park scene shows a sloping green grassy hill where multiple people are standing, sitting, and lying on the grass in small groups. A tall white flagpole near the center-right flies a black, red, and green flag with white fimbriation. Behind the hill and scattered trees, several multi-story buildings are visible, including one with a blue roof directly behind the flagpole and another with a greenish facade to its left, plus a domed building with a spire on the far left. A tall palm tree stands on the far right edge, and a rocky outcrop is in the foreground on the right. The upper portion of the image is filled with an overcast gray and white cloudy sky providing diffuse daylight.
